lines.text: It's three a.m. Everyone's asleep. And someone rings your doorbell.
You look through the peephole. An empty porch.
But the doorbell button is still pressed down...
by a long grey finger, reaching down from above.
Then something bends down... and looks right back at you.
It's twice as tall as your door. Its neck folds like an old ladder.
Long fingers slide in, feeling for you.
It can't fit through the door. But it hears every creak.
Sneak up the creaky stairs to your room...
or stay perfectly still, right next to the door, until it leaves.
Stairs or stay? Tell me in the comments, and follow for more.
